ingredients.title: For the streusel
items: ½ tsp. Diamond Crystal kosher salt
½ cup butter, melted and cooled

ingredients.title: For the cake
items: ½ tsp. Diamond Crystal kosher salt

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease a 9x13 inch baking pan with butter and line with parchment paper. Set aside.

For the streusel, add flour, brown sugar, kosher salt, and cinnamon to a medium bowl. Pour over cooled melted butter and gently combine with a fork, being very careful not to over mix into a paste. Set aside.
For the cinnamon swirl, combine brown sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl. Set aside.

For the cake, mix softened butter with the sugar until smooth and creamy, either by hand or with a stand mixer/electric beaters. Add eggs and vanilla extract, and mix until combined. Gently stir in flour, kosher salt, baking powder, and baking soda. Add sour cream and buttermilk, and mix until incorporated.

Transfer half of the batter into the prepared baking pan and use a knife or offset spatula to spread into an even layer. Sprinkle over cinnamon sugar mixture and add remaining batter over top, doing your best to spread it evenly over the cinnamon sugar mixture. Sprinkle over streusel and bake for 30-35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the cake comes out with moist crumbs.
